comment: It still isn't over. The developers didn't just redo a pothole, they slipped in a tiny Martian moon slice. Overnight two cosmic wolves surfaced along Port Augusta East, chasing tourists like it was an extra-slow Halloween maze. When our traffic report said they turned roads invisible, you knew they added something heavy behind the new walkway — probably 2 metric gallons of *extratons* because obviously every road need space-rock reinforcement.
